I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a {passage}.
This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
Our people are very proud and honest. I guess that's more than most people can say about themselves and their people, right boys?
I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
The boys warn me in advance if a monster is around.
My boys did not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?
The yeti is real and dangerous.
I am not sure what to think about this new custom to accept foreigners as one of us after passing that test. But it's the Jarl's decision, not mine.
The raiders camps are far to the south. There are three of them. Small camp sites of raiding parties might be found almost anywhere though.
They are sometimes trying to catch me and the boys. Such fools, they will never get us. Right, boys?
The boys can tell who's an enemy just by the smell.
I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ...
To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ...
And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. No idea how we made it home. True story.
Me and the boys care only about our own territory.

I guess there are guys like me that have a talent to talk to dogs and there are guys like the shamans that have the talent to talk to spirits.
We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
Sven the Younger is our current Jarl. For my standards he's still a puppy, but a smart one at least.
Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.

reply: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Ho matey.

Greetings. A warning straight ahead: I don't like loiterin'. If you're not here to {help} us, you're here to waste my time. Which I consider loiterin'. Now, try and prove your {worth} to our alliance. ...

I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an opportunity to help destroy the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies.

reply: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.

Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...
I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...
I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ...
But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ...

But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.

If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.

What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.

I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
Melian at your service.
These mountains don't look friendly. I prefer not staying long inbetween my carpet trips.
Only licensed carpet pilots are allowed to fly those.
There's so much green stuff down there that I'm not sure whether there are any, but yes, might be, might be.
Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
That's the name of that dwarven base as far as I know. Got a bit of a pessimistic ring to it if you ask me. Sounds to me like they're starving.

The only humans I've seen on this continent are those that come up to my carpet.
What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
You are probably talking about the {FEMOR hills}.
It's 2:55 pm right now. I think I'm five minutes late in my schedule.

greet: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.

entries.text: Selling weapons and armors to protect mortal souls.

greet: Oh hello. I hardly noticed you. I'm afraid I am a bit distracted at the moment.

entries.text: What a fascinating idea!

greet: Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!

reply: I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.

entries.text: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.

Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

greet: Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.

entries.text: The menu of the day sounds delicious!
The last visit to the theatre was quite rewarding.
Such a beautiful and wealthy city - with so many opportunities ...

greet: Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
send_trade: Choose wisely! Or maybe you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: Come in, young mages! Purchase the latest in runes and wands!
Perhaps I need to bake them hotter? Or was it longer?
Offering all sorts of magic equipment!
Now where did Alaistar put the wood for the new wands?
Hmmm.. Maybe those crushed gems caused the strange side effect?
Wands and rods, the true magician's weapons of choice!

greet: Hello there.

reply: I can forge the finest {weapons} for knights and warriors. They may wear them proudly and visible to everyone.
Would you rather be interested in a {knight's sword} or in a {warrior's sword}?

greet: Oh hello, I wasn't expecting anyone so soon ... What has Sterling told you?

reply: I am Morla, guardian of these turtles.
I watch over the wild turtles and their eggs on Aragonia.
An old friend of mine from Targuna. I bet he sent you here.
They've been capturing turtles and stealing eggs. Please put a stop to them!
My precious turtle eggs are scattered all over the island. Please rescue them!

greet: I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.

entries.text: JAAAAACK? EVERYTHING ALRIGHT DOWN THERE?
Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
Jane!
<grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.

greet: Welcome, young adventurer. If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.

reply: Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.

Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
Mr Morris will do.
There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. My whole life has been full of such steps.
Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.

Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. I like to study their remains.
Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
Exactly. Has a nice ring to it.
She's a good listener if you should still hesitate as to the choice of your definite vocation.
Well, for him it's always been just a question of ''Your gold or your life'' - gold it is nowadays. You can stash your loose change at ol' Abram, but make sure to withdraw it once you leave Dawnport!

Ran across Inigo a few times on some remote islands, years and years ago. Talked him into coming along here, and he seems to enjoy helping newcomers find their way. Passing his knowledge on to the next generation.
We found him here half-dead and fixed him up, now he fixes us dinner and roof beams. Definitely someone you should check out for food, a rope and a shovel.
Been together through many a desperate situation. A romantic underneath it all. Found the time to specialise on spells for paladins and knights somewhere along the way.
Be careful that he doesn't bore you to death with accountants of, well, your bank account history.
He's still down there? And what about the others of his group?
Ah, the goblin who sneaks around here now and then? Lives in a cave to the west, somewhere.

entries.text: I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
<sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
So much to investigate, so little time...
Buying all sorts of creature products!
You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?

farewell: May Daraman be with you on your travels.
greet: Be greeted, foreigner under the sun of Darama. What brings you {here}?

reply: I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
This is our home - the land of the desert.
We will fight that city until we get back what belongs to us.
We avoid these places you call cities.
I would go crazy living in a cage like that.
We have nothing that would be of value for you.
That is the curse for not following the rules of the desert. No son of the desert has ever come back from the dead.
We have nothing that would be of value for you.

walkaway: May Daraman be with you on your travels.

Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.

reply: The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient

The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient

We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?

reply: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

farewell: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
greet: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.

entries.text: Welcome to the post office!
If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!

greet: You are....kind of tall! Hello.
Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!

reply: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
I am able to grant you the heart of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you willing to part with that amount of wealth?

Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...
These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

I know of a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery far to the north of Tiquanda's jungles. He is bound to tell you his secrets and offer you the 'blood of the mountain'. ...
I do not know where exactly but I guess you must first dig that one out to actually talk to him.
I am one with nature, one with the ice and the cold. Names are of no worth out here. Out here, you face isolation and loneliness. Only your strength, willpower and {training} can keep you alive.

My life is one of hardship, hardship I chose freely. Endurance, strength and the power of the will are my only companions in this frigid wilderness. My strength comes from disciplined training and knowledge of the outdoors.

greet: Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
Psst, not that {loud}.
Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!

reply: Well, my name is {Norma}.
I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.

Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
<gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
They tell me strange stories about him and some monsters in a hole. Weird!
That girl thinks that she is soooo special and 'high society'. We used to be friends, but well, things change.
That's probably someone I'll never see in my bar.
<giggles> That monk with his holier-than-thou attitude hasn't anything against a good mug of wine now and then.
If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!
If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!

send_trade: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!

entries.text: Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
<sings> ... are a girl's best friieeend...
Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
Best place in town! Come to my bar!

walkaway: Hey, where are you going? We've just started!

greet: It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
Welcome to Carlin Furniture Store, |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
My name is Nydala. I run this store.
It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?

send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

farewell: Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
greet: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!

reply: Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
{Al Dee} sells torches.
Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...

He is the scourge of the whole continent!
The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
Go and hunt them! For queen and country!

Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.

So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.

Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.

They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.

Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!

Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.

Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.

Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.

This lovely island here. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. Nasty things though live underground, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you!
<shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.

You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.
Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.
Can you believe how old he is? He won't say it, but I wouldn't be surprised if he had been around for loooooong time.
Don't talk to ME about squirrels! <shudders> Had to live off them the first days, when they were the only thing to go into my self-made acorn traps. Nasty.
Don't know what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. Always has a quest or two where he needs help, if you're looking for adventuring work.
Quiet little lady, her. Knows her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff but mostly spends her time in the temple, helping younglings like you choose a vocation.

You know, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that gold in the bank, I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some gold to spend on booze and babes! <winks>
Tries to act tough, but he's quite a witty and decent bloke who wouldn't hurt a fly. We enjoy a good laugh together in the evenings.
I wouldn't be too surprised if the key had been stolen. As often as everybody left it lying around unattended, something like that was bound to happen sooner or later.

I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm. Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.

Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya! Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>

They are no ordinary deer, but a rare magical breed. They are fun and nice, you know. The ugly thing about them is that they prefer a stew made of old, worn boots of haste. Guess that keeps them fast and flying. But what a foul stench!!

If you have any tokens you'd like to turn in, just tell me to turn in the tokens. ... For 1 token you will get a gingerbread man or christmas cookie tray. For 10 tokens I will give you a recipe so you can make your own gingerbread men in the christmas bakery. ... For 25 tokens I will give you a jewel box, while you can trade 50 tokens for a hat, just like the one Santa has. ... 75 tokens are enough for a fluffy santa backpack or a snowflake tapestry, and for 100 tokens you will get a santa doll. I trade 150 tokens for a snowman doll or a snow globe. ... 250 tokens are enough for a frazzlemaw santa, a leaf golem santa, a maxxen santa, a ferumbras' teddy santa, an orclops santa, a santa music box, a santa fox, a nightmare beast santa ... a santa leech, a raccoon santa and finally 500 tokens for a santa teddy.
Name is Saih, I greet you, pilgrim.

The valley has been our home as it has been the home of our ancestors who were separated from the birth-place. It is a place worth fighting for. As is the legacy of the Merudri and everything we achieved.
We are Merudri, this valley has been our sanctuary for centuries and is the only thing left from our true ancestral home.

farewell: Praise the gods, I bid you farewell.
greet: Hm. Greetings.

farewell: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, welcome to the fluid and potion {shop} of Edron.

reply: I sell potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.

entries.text: Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.

walkaway: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.

greet: ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.

reply: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.
Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
You want to help me? HELP me? You? Who... who are you anyway? Ah nevermind.

entries.text: Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
Nasty creepy crawlies!
Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!

walkaway: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.

greet: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.

entries.text: General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!

reply: My name is Scott.
It's a peaceful island. Cold and lonesome but I like it.
I'm the keeper of the inn. You can buy food here.
Oh, I'm happy to live in this world full of thrilling things.
It is said that there are some secrets to discover around the mage's castle.
Sometimes I travel to Carlin and visit the market.
It's a city in the south-west of Tibia.
She is a strong and wise leader. We owe her protection from evil monsters.

A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives! ... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me! ... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same. ... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared. ... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip. ... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood. ... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it. ... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet. Travellers told me that they recently moved into the caverns beneath the island. There, they are growing fresh grass and even flowers! How is that possible in a frozen cave? Some kind of magic has to be involved. ... I'm just not sure whether it is of the benevolent or the malicious kind.

entries.text: Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!

greet: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Ab'dendriel?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Edron?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Venore?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Darashia?
My name is Scrutinon. However, there are not many people calling my name nowadays. Not many captains even dare to land on this island. It is too close to {Quirefang}. ...
Most of them do not know this island by that name. Some call it Demon Horn, others the Dragon's Tooth or the Gray Beach as none of them ever came closer than a fair distance. ...

There are drifts and storms surrounding that place that are far too dangerous to navigate through even for the most versed captains. They often sail not closer than to this island here and drop off whoever dares to explore near this dreaded coast.

greet: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Meriana for |TRAVELCOST|?
Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
I am the captain of this ship.
I am the captain of this ship.

greet: If you don't carry any spares, state your business quickly or move along.

reply: I will get back to this later. Now either you're just a confused bystander or you're on a mission to get on my nerves. What will it be?
If you can't tell me why you're here, stop distracting me and at least try helping some of my men knocking this measly camp into shape!

How did you even manage to get here with that sorry excuse of a sailing boat? So you say Kesar himself sent you, giving you details he did not disclose, even to us? And do you have any proof for that outrageous claim?
Royal Bounacean advisor? Why should Kesar constitute someone like you, this is saying nothing without proof. Has he really told you what this is all about?
A bastard?! Lower your voice, stranger, that's no trifling matter. At all... you say you have solid evidence of this?
A certificate of... oh my. That should have stirred something up in the ivory tower, heh. ...
Alright... well, excuse my temper, it's all hands on deck for us since we barely set foot on this accursed rock. Let's take a break and start this conversation properly. ...

We need to find the heir of this Eldoran then. His knights must be on this island somewhere, but we did not encounter any of them so far. If the threat you mentioned is real, they may be in grave danger, as are we. ...
Fight your way through the mines and further into the isle. We need to get to the bottom of this and we also need to find a way to survive: there is no escaping for us in our current state.

entries.text: Strategy wins wars, not just brute force.
Every detail matters in battle.

greet: Be greeted, young adventurer.

Would you like to learn {brutal strike} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?

In this category I have '{Find person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', '{Great Light}', and '{Haste}'.
In this category I have '{Brutal strike}' for knights.
In this category I have '{Conjure Arrow}' for paladins.
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells}, {conjure spells} and {attack spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
I am Ser Tybald. <bows courteously>.
I'm just an adventurer looking for action. Learn from the best! Just ask me about knight and paladin {spells}.

From afar, the island glowed at midnight as if dawn was at hand. A fierce magical light, beckoning, calling out, promising power past redemption - but I am sure {Garamond} has a better idea as to the exact nature of that magical power.
He's a mentor to all young adventurers. If you have a question as to what you should or could do, and how this world works, talk to Inigo, he will be happy to help.
Now there is someone who has had his share of grief. No wonder he came to {Dawnport} to assist raising new heroes for the {Tibian} lands.
Is that old man still teaching magic spells?
We know each other from old, yes. Will we talk about it? No.
That old pirate has settled down now it seems.
He's quite a good cook, which helps improve the mood on bad days. He's a carpenter by trade. Did a good job reinforcing this outpost, too.
It used to be a kind of title in other times, but it serves nicely as a first name here.
Each vocation has their own unique spells to enhance their fighting or defense, which none of the other vocations can use, and which you can only learn at a spell trainer of your vocation.
Most of the major cities are on the Tibian mainland, such as the rich merchant city of Venore, for example. You will find spell teachers for your vocation in almost every major city.

Tibia is the world we live in. Rookgaard is not far off from the Tibian {mainland}, though it's a tricky passage with contrary winds. On the mainland, you will find more adventure, mystery and monsters and can prove yourself a hero or villain.

What a beautiful lady. Do you know the Lay of the White Lady Illadria? ... 'Calm and slender like a birch, soft and white like snow, yet strong and warm like the sun she is.' Well, it fits perfectly. I am her sworn protector.
Ah, still so young and naive about the gods and demons... Still, I envy him his unspoilt beliefs. If I could turn back time... but never mind my ramblings.
Mr Morris has much on his mind and may have been somewhat distracted with regard to that key. He probably just misplaced it, somewhere on top of all those archeological findings he stores.
